target_profile.scope: Native Apple-silicon macOS binaries, including required public and Apple-specific extensions and ABI behavior; host extensions selected by explicit capability checks.
target_profile.inventory_limits: Reviewed shared A64 forms only. This list is not a complete Apple CPU feature contract, private-extension inventory, or binary-compatibility denominator.

instruction_sources.redistribution_scope: Only factual identifiers, names, categorical/feature metadata and fixed encoding bits are included. Arm XML, authored instruction prose and pseudocode remain local and are not redistributed.

profile.description: Classic software PAuth1 VA47 with explicit key domain and two bounded clock operations. Full standard A64 reference checklist assessments; no Apple hardware signature identity.
outside_scope: all system-register/barrier operations except admitted clock forms

status_policy: Block and leaf counts are separate profile assessments of canonical forms. Nine forms overlap; counts must not be added. No Apple ISA or compatibility denominator is established.

generic_pauth_code.key_domain: Independent APGA key; no reuse of IA/IB/DA/DB key slots.

forms.review: Pinned June2026 operand semantics and QARMA5 GA reviewed; genuine original ARM/full-State native comparison through actual baseline and checked blocks, cold/hot/disk/AOT cache paths and source maps.
forms.scope: Complete PACGA form in explicit QARMA5 Context profile stela-classic-arm64e-qarma5-va47-itbi0-dtbi1-explicit-keys-ga-v1 with an independently supplied APGA key; Rn31 is ZR, Rm31 is SP, Rd31 discards only after key/service validation; lower32 result bits zero; original flags/FP/SIMD preserved. No Apple hardware key identity or architectural exception delivery claim.

forms.review: Exact pinned June2026 load form, operand/authentication/alignment/read/commit order and checked MemoryThread reader reviewed; original/native complete State/RAM and fault policy through cold/hot/disk/AOT paths with actual baseline/checked body and source-map bridges.
forms.scope: Complete selected form under explicit FPACCOMBINE/QARMA5 Context stela-fpaccombine-qarma5-va47-itbi0-dtbi1-explicit-keys-v1, VA47/iTBI0/dTBI1, EL0, A=0 and DA/DB authentication enabled, with SA0 off/on. Rn31 is original SP and Rt31 discards only after service/read validation. Validate descriptor, select UNDEF for pre-index Rn=Rt!=31, authenticate with zero modifier, check original SP, add signed scaled8 offset, perform checked 64-bit read, then commit destination/writeback. Reader privilege comes from authoritative EL; tagchecked=writeback||Rn!=31 and nontemporal=false. Faults preserve pending destination/base. QEMU SP-check omission and permitted overlap choices remain separate source-policy evidence; A1, disabled-key execution, Apple hardware key identity and architectural exception delivery are uncredited.
